prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent personal music trophy for a mobile app.
Style: premium tactile 3D miniature sculpture matching a burnt-orange enamel vintage turntable, polished enamel, midnight-black vinyl grooves, brushed silver, dark-plum pedestal. Warm studio illumination, beautiful charming object rather than a generic sports cup.
Composition: one entire centered award, front three-quarter view, distinct silhouette at 120px, genuinely transparent alpha and soft contact shadow.
Palette: #ed642f orange, #62354b plum, #f7f0e7 cream, #edc9d7 pink, #242426 black, brushed silver.
Constraints: no text, letters, numerals, stars, sparkle icons, laurels, logos, watermark, people, UI or backdrop. Make the semantic object unmistakable.
Subject: a miniature sculptural burnt-orange electric guitar with black pickups, fine silver strings and a cream pickguard, mounted upright on a plum pedestal with a small vinyl base. Represents rock, guitar, riff and metal music awards.
derivative: Resized to 640px (player) or 320px (trophy), WebP quality 88; alpha preserved.
